title: Trump pardons 5 ex-NFL players — including Jets legend Joe Klecko — for crimes ranging from perjury to drug trafficking

sources.name: ESPN NFL
sources.title: Trump pardons include Klecko, Newton, Lewis
sources.description: President Donald Trump on Thursday pardoned former NFL players Joe Klecko, Nate Newton, Jamal Lewis, Travis Henry and the late Billy Cannon on Thursday.
